The '''Phaegon system''' was in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It contained four [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Phaegon III]]. Each planet had multiple [[Moon/Legends|moons]] orbiting them. An [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] was located between the third and fourth planets of the system.
